## About Me

I'm a **Computer Science student at Umm Al-Qura University** interested in **Data Analysis and Data Visualization**.

## Projects

### [Amazon Sales Analysis](https://github.com/Abdallah-9i/amazon-sales-analysis)

End-to-end analysis of 128,969 Amazon sales records: data cleaning, exploratory analysis, SQL analysis and Power BI dashboard.

**Tools:** Python, Pandas, PostgreSQL, Power BI

**Status:** ✅ Completed

### [Letterboxd Stars Analysis](https://github.com/Abdallah-9i/letterboxd-stars-analysis)

Analyzing 11M+ Letterboxd movie ratings to explore audience preferences, genre popularity, user behavior, and rating trends across release years.

**Tools:** Python, Pandas, Jupyter Notebook, PostgreSQL, Power BI

**Status:** 🚧 Work in Progress
